Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Gear sections now auto-untick when their armoury chest section reaches 100%. Active AutoBuy runs immediately skip any remaining items from an unticked or newly full gear section. The 100% check is based on the armoury section itself and ignores normal inventory.
